data.one_liner: Convert HTML with inline CSS into Flutter RichText widgets.
data.what_it_does: The package parses HTML strings and CSS style attributes, building a TextSpan hierarchy that Flutter can render as RichText. It supports most text‑related CSS properties and link callbacks.
use_when: You need to display simple styled HTML content without a full web view
You want lightweight inline‑style support for text in a Flutter app
avoid_when: Complex layouts or CSS features beyond text styling are required
You need full CSS layout, animations, or JavaScript support
weaknesses: Limited to text‑related CSS, no alignment or block layout support
